meaning: adj. 難以置信的；不大可能的

The fragile shipping container was clearly marked to warn personnel about the extreme fragility of the glass lenses. (易碎品包裝箱上有清楚標示，提醒搬運人員玻璃鏡片極易破損。)
The shaman's trance ritual was driven by a primal urge to protect the agrarian village from unpredictable droughts. (薩滿的恍惚儀式源自保護農村免受不可預測乾旱侵害的原始衝動。)
The historical emperor acquired the famous epithet 'the Great' following his decisive military triumphs. (這位歷史上的皇帝在取得決定性軍事勝利後，獲得了「大帝」這個著名稱號。)
Handcrafting large woodcut illustrations on rigid cedar slabs was an extremely slow and laborious process for preindustrial artisans. (工業化前的工匠在堅硬雪松板上手工製作大型木刻插圖，是非常緩慢又費力的工作。)
The highly stylized, strict frontality artwork of pyramids stands as the absolute epitome of Egyptian antiquity. (高度風格化且採用嚴格正面構圖的金字塔藝術，堪稱古埃及的典型。)

meaning:

Honey is a highly viscous liquid compared to water. (與水相比，蜂蜜是一種高度黏稠的液體。)
An aristocratic connoisseur of classical Mediterranean antiquity could quickly distinguish authentic glazed statuary arts. (一位精通古典地中海古代藝術的貴族鑑賞家，能迅速辨認上釉雕像的真品。)
The early diplomatic skirmishes over trade barriers served to foreshadow the full-scale geopolitical conflict. (早期圍繞貿易壁壘的外交衝突，預示了全面地緣政治衝突的到來。)
Persistent socioeconomic antagonism sparked intense political antipathy between home-based workers and factory owners. (持續的社會經濟對立，使家庭代工者與工廠業主之間產生強烈政治反感。)
Atmospheric convection currents cause regional temperatures to oscillate dynamically across semiarid highland plateau basins. (大氣對流使半乾旱高原盆地的區域氣溫劇烈波動。)

In mutualistic alliances, host legume plants regularly reciprocate by transferring glucose starches back to symbiotic root microbes. (在互利共生關係中，豆科宿主植物會定期把葡萄糖回饋給共生根部微生物。)
The Iroquois Confederacy was a highly sophisticated political alliance consisting of distinct indigenous tribes. (易洛魁聯盟是一個由不同原住民族群組成、制度高度複雜的政治聯盟。)
The artistic director was hired to choreograph the complex dance routines for the Broadway musical production. (這位藝術總監受聘為百老匯音樂劇編排複雜的舞蹈動作。)
The historic citadel stood atop the rocky mountain, acting as a defensive refuge for the townspeople. (這座歷史悠久的城堡聳立在岩山頂上，充當城鎮居民的防禦避難所。)
The massive preponderance of specialized angiosperm plants inside modern equatorial zones began during late Cretaceous adaptive radiations. (赤道地區被子植物的大量增加，始於白堊紀晚期的適應輻射。)
The pioneer homesteader registered a substantial agricultural acreage, preparing the flat midwest plain for crop cultivation. (拓荒農莊主登記了一大片農地，並準備在平坦的中西部平原種植作物。)

meaning:

Under a microscope, the circular chondrule inclusion displayed distinct concentric rings of crystalline minerals. (在顯微鏡下，圓形球粒內含物呈現出清晰的同心礦物結晶環。)

meaning: adj. 自律神經的；自動調節的

meaning: adj. 大量的；龐大的；（衣服）寬大的

Paleolithic gatherers maintained constant hearth fires, carefully transferring a glowing charcoal ember during migrations. (舊石器時代的採集者維持著穩定的灶火，在遷移過程中細心地轉移一塊發光的木炭餘燼。)
Heavy rainfall caused a flash flood to rush through the narrow desert ravine, eroding the loose rock formations. (暴雨引發了山洪暴發，沖過狹窄的沙漠溝壑，侵蝕了鬆散的岩石結構。)

meaning: adj. 未預料到的；意料之外的
example: The Little Ice Age cooling triggered severe, unanticipated crop failures across temperate farmlands. (小冰河期的全球降溫，導致溫帶農地出現嚴重且意料之外的歉收。)

meaning: adj. 無庸置疑的；無爭議的

The museum features tactile exhibits designed for visually impaired visitors. (該博物館設有專為視障遊客設計的觸覺展品。)
A turbulent ocean eddy can trap and concentrate microscopic plankton, attracting diverse marine predators. (湍急的海洋渦流能困住並聚集微小浮游生物，吸引各種海洋掠食者。)
The vascular conduits of angiosperm stems are composed of elongated fibrous cells that efficiently conduct fluids. (被子植物莖部的維管導管由細長的纖維細胞組成，能有效傳導液體。)
Lichens can colonize bare granite by anchoring securely inside a microscopic stone crevice. (地衣能透過在微小的石頭裂縫內牢固地錨定，從而拓殖裸露的花崗岩。)
The historic industrial city maintained an economic predominance in steel manufacturing throughout the late twentieth century. (在整個20世紀後期，這座歷史悠久的工業城市在鋼鐵製造業中保持著經濟上的主導地位。)
The modern corporation was formed through the complex amalgamation of several independent technology startups. (這家現代化企業是透過幾家獨立科技新創公司的複雜合併而成立的。)
The geometric motifs engraved onto the archaic slab were distinctly asymmetrical, puzzling the historical geographer. (雕刻在古老厚板上的幾何圖案明顯不對稱，這讓歷史地理學家感到困惑。)
Placental mammals give birth to relatively mature offspring compared to marsupial species. (與有袋類動物相比，胎盤哺乳動物產下的後代發育相對成熟。)
The sudden introduction of a virulent biological invader can completely annihilate an isolated island's native angiosperm community. (突然引入一種具毒性的生物入侵者，會完全消滅一座孤立島嶼的原生被子植物群落。)
Feelings of psychological inferiority can sometimes severely hinder an individual's career advancement and social confidence. (心理上的自卑感有時會嚴重阻礙個人的職涯發展與社交自信。)
The historical campus courtyard was shaded by a massive, century-old American elm tree. (歷史悠久的校園庭院被一棵巨大的、有百年歷史的美國榆樹所遮蔽。)
The carver etched complex mythological imagery onto the flat limestone slab to decorate the centralized ancestral temple. (雕刻師將複雜的神話意象刻在平坦的石灰岩厚板上，裝飾中央的祖廟。)

meaning: n. 導電率；傳導性（如水/熱傳導）

meaning: n. 新生兒；剛孵化的動物
example: A marsupial neonate is born in an exceptionally underdeveloped state, completing its growth within its mother's pouch. (有袋類新生幼體出生時發育極不完整，會在母親的育兒袋中完成生長。)

The woolly mammoth possessed exceptional anatomical adaptations designed to endure the frigid climate of the Ice Age. (長毛象具備卓越的解剖適應能力，旨在忍受冰河時期的嚴寒氣候。)

An independent pioneer prospector mapped out the southwestern desert, searching for potash and manganese veins. (一位獨立的拓荒探礦者勘測西南部沙漠，尋找碳酸鉀與錳礦脈。)

meaning: adj. 部分的；部門的；組合式的

meaning: v. 覓食腐肉、搜尋可用之物

meaning: adj. 有條不紊的、有系統的

meaning: n. 習慣性動作；特殊習慣；風格

meaning: adj. 迷人的；有吸引力的
example: The professor gave an engaging lecture on ancient history. (教授發表了一場關於古代歷史的迷人演講。)
The professor spent the entire weekend grading exam papers. (教授整個週末都在批改試卷。)
Archaeologists discovered Mesolithic tools near the ancient river bank. (考古學家在古河岸附近發現了中石器時代的工具。)
Excessive fertilizer runoff into rivers can provoke a massive bloom of algae, depleting dissolved oxygen. (過量的肥料逕流進入河流會引發藻類大量增殖，消耗掉溶解氧。)

meaning: n. 社會道德淪喪；無規範狀態
example: Sociologists use the term anomie to describe the psychological breakdown of individuals when social norms collapse. (社會學家使用「無規範狀態」一詞來形容社會規範崩潰時個人的心理崩潰。)
The rigid lithospheric plates float dynamically upon the semi-fluid asthenosphere, driven by deep mantle convection currents. (僵硬的岩石圈板塊在深層地函對流的驅動下，動態地漂浮在半流動的軟流圈之上。)
A specialized anaerobic bacterium can survive deep inside oceanic rifts where oxygen is completely absent. (一種特化的厭氧細菌可以在氧氣完全缺乏的海洋裂谷深處存活下來。)
The Carboniferous period featured extensive swamp forests whose compressed plant layers eventually formed modern coal deposits. (石炭紀有大片沼澤森林，植物層受壓後逐漸形成現代煤層。)
The Cenozoic era is labeled the 'Age of Mammals' due to the rapid diversification of mammalian life. (新生代因哺乳動物的快速多樣化而被標記為「哺乳動物時代」。)
A specialized anti-reflective coating was applied to the optical lenses to maximize light transmission. (光學鏡片上塗覆了一層專業的防反射塗層，以最大化光線的穿透率。)

meaning: adj. 片利共生的；共生生物
example: The symbiotic alliance between a shark and a remora fish represents a classic commensal interaction where the host is unaffected. (鯊魚與鮣魚之間的共生同盟，代表了一種經典的片利共生互動，其中宿主完全不受影響。)
Commensalism describes an alliance where one organism benefits while the other remains entirely unaffected. (片利共生描述了一種同盟關係，其中一種生物受益，而另一種生物則完全不受影響。)
The Cretaceous period concluded with a mass extinction event that wiped out the non-avian dinosaurs. (白堊紀以一場大規模滅絕事件結束，該事件清除了非鳥類的恐龍。)

meaning: adj. 嚴重傷害的；令人癱瘓的
example: The economic sanctions had a crippling effect on the nation's manufacturing sector, leading to widespread inflation. (經濟制裁對該國的製造業造成了癱瘓性的打擊，導致了普遍的通貨膨脹。)

meaning: adj. 公正的；無私利的；不感興趣的
example: A judge must remain an entirely disinterested party throughout the trial to guarantee a fair legal outcome. (法官在整個審判過程中都必須保持公正，不偏袒任何一方，以確保判決公平。)
Through dogged determination and years of hard work, the scientist finally discovered a vaccine for the disease. (憑藉著頑強的決心與多年的努力，這位科學家終於發現了該疾病的疫苗。)
Reptiles are fundamentally ectothermic animals that must rely on environmental heat sources to regulate their body temperature. (爬行動物基本上是外溫動物，必須依賴環境熱源來調節體溫。)
The intricate wood engraving allowed early publishers to mass-produce detailed visual illustrations for texts. (精細的木刻版畫讓早期出版商得以大量印製細緻的文字插圖。)
The museum acquired a rare seventeenth-century copper etching depicting the historic city's skyline. (博物館收藏了一幅珍稀的十七世紀銅版畫，描繪歷史城市的天際線。)
Behind his calm professional façade, the executive was experiencing immense stress regarding the company's future. (在他冷靜專業的外表假象之下，這位主管正承受著對公司未來的巨大壓力。)

meaning: adj. 牽強的；難以置信的
example: Critics argued that the sci-fi movie's plot was entirely far-fetched and defied basic physical laws. (評論家認為這部科幻電影的劇情完全牽強附會，且違背了基本的物理定律。)
Fossilization requires rapid burial beneath sediment to prevent decomposition and scavenging by predators. (化石化需要迅速埋入沉積物下，避免分解或遭掠食者啃食。)
The founding of the Iroquois Confederacy formalized legal and organizational agreements across five separate indigenous tribes. (易洛魁聯盟的創立，正式確立了五個原住民族群之間的法律與組織協議。)
Fungi play a vital role in ecosystems by decomposing dead organic matter. (真菌會分解死亡的有機物，在生態系中扮演重要角色。)

meaning: adj. 哥德式的；哥德風格的
example: The midwest metropolis cathedral featured a grandiose Gothic facade, showcasing strict architectural symmetry and masonry towers. (中西部都會區的大教堂以宏偉的哥德式立面著稱，展現嚴謹的建築對稱與石砌塔樓。)

meaning: adj. 艱鉅的；需要巨大力量的
example: Cleaning up the toxic waste spill required a herculean effort from both government agencies and local volunteers. (清理有毒廢棄物外洩需要政府機關與當地志工付出艱鉅努力。)

meaning: n. 拓荒者；自耕定居者
example: Each western homesteader had to construct a permanent stone homestead and cultivate sparse fields to secure legal title. (每位西部拓荒者都必須建造永久性的石造宅居並耕種貧瘠田地，才能取得合法土地所有權。)
Modern soilless agriculture setups utilize balanced hydroponic nutrient fluid channels to accelerate crop maturation phases. (現代無土農業設備利用配比均衡的水耕營養液管道，加快作物成熟。)

meaning: adj. 其間的；介於兩者之間的
example: During the intervening years, the small village grew into a bustling city. (在這段期間，小村莊發展成繁忙的城市。)
The historical genealogical records document how early pioneer kinfolk settled collectively in the valley. (歷史族譜記錄了早期拓荒者親屬如何一同在山谷定居。)
The commuter visited the subway station's lost-and-found department to recover her forgotten briefcase. (這名通勤者前往地鐵站的失物招領處，取回遺忘的公事包。)

meaning: n. 金屬工匠；金屬加工者
example: An expert Bronze Age metalworker melted mineral ores inside an airtight kiln to forge durable tools. (一位熟練的青銅時代金屬工匠在密閉窯中熔化礦石，打造耐用工具。)
Computer modeling helps meteorologists predict the path of severe hurricanes. (電腦建模有助於氣象學家預測強烈颶風的路徑。)

meaning: n. 互利共生；互惠關係
example: The alliance between clownfish and sea anemones is a textbook example of obligate marine mutualism. (小丑魚與海葵的聯盟是海洋專性互利共生的典型例子。)
Genetic evidence indicates that modern humans and Neanderthals interbred before the latter went extinct. (基因證據顯示，現代人類與尼安德塔人在後者滅絕前曾交配繁衍。)

meaning: n. 游牧生活；游牧制度
example: Pastoral nomadism represents an adaptation to arid biomes where water sources are ephemeral and widely scattered. (畜牧游牧是對乾旱生態區的一種適應，因為水源短暫且分布分散。)

meaning: adj. 深成岩的；地下凝固形成的
example: Granite is a classic plutonic igneous rock formation, characterized by massive interlocking crystal grains shaped deep within mantle zones. (花崗岩是典型的深成火成岩，其特徵是由地函深處形成的大型互鎖晶粒構成。)

meaning: adj. 尚未發展文字的；文字出現前的
example: Anthropologists analyze cave drawings and oral traditions to study the social structures of preliterate societies. (人類學家分析洞穴壁畫與口述傳統，研究尚未發展文字的社會結構。)
Through her pioneering work in primatology, Jane Goodall revolutionized our understanding of chimpanzee behavior. (珍古德透過開創性的靈長類學研究，徹底改變了我們對黑猩猩行為的理解。)
There is a pronounced difference between the two statistical models. (這兩個統計模型之間存在著明顯的差異。)

meaning: adj. 半乾旱的；半乾燥的
example: Semiarid ecosystems receive low overall precipitation and are vulnerable to desertification via overgrazing. (半乾旱生態系統的總降雨量較低，易因過度放牧而發生沙漠化。)

meaning: adj. 全面的；大幅度的；影響廣泛的
example: The newly elected Prime Minister promised to introduce sweeping economic reforms to reduce national debt. (新當選的總理承諾引入徹底的經濟改革以減少國家債務。)

meaning: n. 遠距工作；遠距辦公
example: The advent of high-speed digital networks enabled telecommuting, altering traditional urban commuting patterns. (高速數位網路的出現實現了遠距辦公，改變了傳統的都市通勤型態。)
Avian evolutionary theorists argue that modern birds descended directly from a specialized lineage of Mesozoic theropod dinosaurs. (鳥類演化理論家認為，現代鳥類直接起源於中生代獸腳亞目恐龍的一個特化血統。)
Above the alpine timberline, harsh environmental conditions prevent the growth of tall trees. (在高山林木線以上，惡劣的環境條件阻礙了高大樹木的生長。)

meaning: n. 圖騰崇拜；圖騰制度
example: Anthropological surveys demonstrate that ancestral totemism rituals frequently incorporated stylized figural imagery of avian falcon deities. (人類學調查顯示，祖先流傳的圖騰崇拜儀式常融入遊隼神明的風格化具象圖像。)

meaning: adj. 高聳的；巨大的；傑出的
example: The towering skyscrapers dominated the skyline of the modern city. (高聳的摩天大樓主宰了這座現代城市的天際線。)
Launching a space mission to explore Mars is a colossal and highly expensive scientific undertaking. (啟動探索火星的太空任務是一項巨大且成本極其高昂的科學事業。)

meaning: adj. 未經證實的；未核實的
example: The news agency refused to publish the controversial story because the sources remained unverified. (這家新聞機構拒絕發表這篇引發爭議的報導，因為消息來源仍未經證實。)
Rocks undergo weathering over thousands of years due to wind and rain. (由於風吹雨打，岩石在數千年間經歷了風化作用。)
Cuneiform is an ancient system of writing characterized by wedge-shaped marks. (楔形文字是一種古代書寫系統，其特點是楔形符號。)

meaning: n. 階梯式神塔；金字形神塔
example: Archeologists excavated the ruins of an ancient Mesopotamian ziggurat dedicated to the lunar deity. (考古學家挖掘了一座供奉月亮神祇的古代美索不達米亞梯形金字塔遺跡。)

meaning: phr. 勉強維持；勉強取得
example: The impoverished agrarian sharecroppers had to labor intensely to eke out a meager subsistence from the dry soil. (貧困的佃農必須辛勤工作，才能從乾旱的土地勉強維持生計。)
Water pollution is the serious issue residents raise most often, especially those living near the old factory. (水污染是居民最常提出的嚴重問題，尤其是住在附近老工廠旁的人。)
The visa process took six weeks, mostly because one simple document had been uploaded incorrectly. (簽證流程花了六週，主要是因為一份簡單文件上傳錯誤。)
The unemployment rate fell slightly last month, according to the latest official figures. (根據官方數據，上個月的失業率略為下降。)

meaning: adj. 政治的；政治相關的
example: The debate became political when someone raised the difficult question of local taxation. (有人提出地方稅制這個棘手問題後，這場討論就變得政治化了。)
Her account of the long journey was vivid, describing the dust, the heat and the kindness of strangers. (她對這趟漫長旅程的敘述很生動，描述了塵土、酷熱和陌生人的善意。)
Recent research suggests that short naps can improve afternoon performance at work. (最近的研究顯示，短暫午睡能提升下午的工作表現。)
The patient's serious condition improved gradually after major surgery, although he still needs supplementary oxygen every single night. (病人嚴重的病況在大手術後逐漸改善，不過他每晚仍需補充氧氣。)
The housing situation has improved slightly since the new flats were completed. (新公寓完工後，住宅狀況已略有改善。)
The local library has become a meeting place for the whole community. (當地圖書館已成為整個社區的聚會場所。)
The contract is long, but the important details are on page three. (合約很長，但重要細節在第三頁。)

meaning: adj. 經濟上的；經濟相關的
example: Many young people leave for economic reasons, even though their home town offers a quieter and cheaper life. (許多年輕人基於經濟理由離開，儘管家鄉提供更安靜、更便宜的生活。)
Their approach to the problem was refreshingly practical, focusing on small everyday changes rather than costly complete redesigns. (他們處理這個問題的方法實際得令人耳目一新，著重日常小改變而非昂貴的全面重新設計。)
Regular adult smokers face a much higher risk of serious heart disease than non-smokers. (有規律吸菸習慣的成年人罹患嚴重心臟病的風險遠高於不吸菸者。)
One clear benefit of working from home regularly is that employees save both commuting time and a considerable amount of money. (規律居家辦公的一項明顯益處，是員工同時省下通勤時間和可觀的金錢。)
His exam performance suffered, mainly because he had slept very little the night before. (他的考試表現受了影響，主要是因為前一晚睡眠不足。)
Digital technology has changed how people shop, bank and communicate with friends. (數位科技改變了人們購物、理財和與朋友溝通的方式。)
The company suddenly faced serious financial difficulties after losing its largest overseas customer. (這家公司在失去最大海外客戶後，突然面臨嚴重的財務困難。)
Careful analysis of the local river samples revealed traces of pesticide, prompting officials to warn nearby farmers immediately. (仔細分析當地河水樣本後發現農藥殘留，促使官員立即警告附近農民。)
There is clear evidence of ancient settlement here, including tools and the remains of a small stone wall. (這裡有古代定居的明確證據，包括工具和一道小石牆的殘跡。)
The city significantly reduced speed limits near local schools, and serious accidents fell sharply within the first year. (市政府大幅調降當地學校附近的速限，嚴重事故在第一年內就明顯減少。)
Cost is an important factor in the decision, but passenger safety must come first. (成本是這項決定中的重要因素，但乘客安全必須優先。)
The response to the public flood appeal was generous, with donations arriving from towns hundreds of miles away. (民眾對水災募款的反應很踴躍，捐款也從數百英里外的城鎮送來。)
Demand for bottled water soared during the heatwave, and several local supermarkets ran out completely within a few hours. (熱浪期間瓶裝水需求暴增，好幾家當地超市幾小時內就完全售罄。)
Family structure has changed greatly in recent decades, and more grandparents now help with daily childcare. (家庭結構近幾十年來變化很大，越來越多祖父母如今分擔日常托育。)
The phone's standout feature is its battery, which actually lasts two full days even with constant heavy use. (這支手機最突出的特色是電池，即使持續重度使用，實際上也能撐滿兩天。)
Poor time management causes many students unnecessary stress, especially when several essays are due in the same week. (時間管理不善讓許多學生承受不必要的壓力，尤其是好幾篇報告同一週截止時。)
The famous painting represents a busy harbour, though the artist never actually visited the coast during his lifetime. (這幅名畫呈現一個繁忙的港口，不過畫家生前其實從未到過海邊。)
They established a small local charity to repair bicycles, giving unused bikes to students who cannot afford transport. (他們成立了一個小型地方慈善組織來修理腳踏車，把閒置的車送給付不起交通費的學生。)
The average monthly rainfall for July is usually high, but this year the total was far below normal. (七月的平均月雨量通常很高，但今年的總量遠低於正常值。)
The new tunnel brought genuinely significant benefits, cutting the journey for local commuters to the airport by nearly half. (新隧道帶來真正重大的益處，讓當地通勤族前往機場的路程縮短將近一半。)
Their first attempt to climb the peak failed, but they learned from the experience. (他們第一次嘗試攀登那座高峰失敗了，但仍從這次經驗中學到東西。)
The economy grew slowly last year because exports fell sharply in the final quarter. (去年經濟成長緩慢，因為出口在最後一季大幅下滑。)

meaning: adj. 各種各樣的；不同的
example: People volunteer for various reasons, from gaining new experience to simply meeting local neighbours in a friendly setting. (人們當志工的理由各種各樣，從獲得新經驗到單純在友善的環境中認識鄰居都有。)
The government raised tax on cigarettes in order to reduce the number of smokers. (政府提高香菸稅，以減少吸菸人數。)
A series of small delays made the journey frustrating, though the train eventually arrived only ten minutes late. (一連串小延誤讓旅程令人煩躁，不過火車最後只晚了十分鐘抵達。)
The two sides finally reached an agreement on the sharing of water resources. (雙方終於就水資源分配達成協議。)
Careful forensic tests identified the victim within a few days. (仔細的法醫檢驗在短短幾天內確認了受害者身分。)
The contract gives no specific date for completing the repairs to the roof. (這份合約沒有明確訂出屋頂修繕完工的日期。)
I hardly recognized the square after they removed all the old trees. (他們把老樹全移走後，我幾乎認不出這個廣場。)
The winter climb is a serious physical challenge, so always prepare carefully and never go alone. (冬季攀登是嚴峻的體能挑戰，因此一定要仔細準備，且絕不要獨自前往。)
The theory sounds fully convincing, yet no single experiment has ever produced evidence strong enough to support it. (這個理論聽起來完全有說服力，但從沒有任何單一實驗產生足以支持它的證據。)
Despite a painful knee injury, she finished the marathon and even slightly improved on her previous best time. (儘管膝傷疼痛，她仍跑完馬拉松，甚至略微刷新自己先前的最佳成績。)
The government released the full report on Friday, quietly hoping fewer people would notice its clearly embarrassing conclusions. (政府在週五公布完整報告，悄悄希望較少人注意到其中明顯令人難堪的結論。)

meaning: n. 取得的機會；使用權
example: Rural children often lack access to good local schools, so many families move closer to the nearest town. (鄉村孩子往往缺乏就讀良好本地學校的管道，因此許多家庭搬到最近的城鎮附近。)
The annual conference brings together researchers from more than thirty different countries. (年度會議聚集來自三十多個不同國家的研究人員。)
Teachers often underestimate the genuine potential of quieter students, who may produce more thoughtful work when given time. (教師常低估安靜學生的真正潛力，這些學生只要有時間，往往能交出更有深度的作品。)
Her job application was very strong, yet the panel finally chose someone with considerably more relevant practical experience. (她的求職申請很出色，但評審最後選了具備更多相關實務經驗的人。)
The rail network is being upgraded to cope with rising passenger numbers. (鐵路網正在升級，以因應不斷增加的乘客量。)
The company needs a clear strategy for reducing its dependence on coal. (公司需要明確的策略來減少對煤炭的依賴。)
The author spent five years interviewing families affected by the factory closure. (作者花了五年訪問受工廠關閉影響的家庭。)
The pressure at work suddenly increased again, so she eventually asked for two weeks of much-needed unpaid leave. (工作壓力又突然增加，因此她最後申請了兩週亟需的無薪假。)
Fierce competition at the flower show pushed gardeners to breed increasingly unusual roses, fascinating visitors. (花展的激烈競爭促使園藝家培育越來越奇特的玫瑰，讓參觀者著迷。)

meaning: n. 推薦信；推薦人評語
example: Landlords often ask for a written reference from a previous landlord, which makes moving to the city difficult for newcomers. (房東常要求提供前任房東的書面推薦，讓初來城市的人很難搬進城裡。)
The argument's conclusion was clear, yet the supporting evidence remained surprisingly weak. (論證的結論很清楚，但支持它的證據仍出乎意料地薄弱。)
The report defines poverty in terms of income, health and adequate housing. (這份報告從收入、健康和適足住房來界定貧窮。)
The new report refers to rapidly falling birth rates but says little about how local schools should respond. (這份新報告提到生育率快速下降，卻很少談到地方學校該如何因應。)
The disease spread quickly through the crowded camp before clean water arrived. (乾淨的水送達前，這種疾病在擁擠的營地裡迅速傳播。)
Property prices near the new station have risen much faster than local wages. (新車站附近的房地產價格，漲幅遠超過當地薪資。)
The bus company made a profit last year, but it still plans to raise fares and cut rural routes. (這家公車公司去年有獲利，卻仍計畫調漲票價並裁減鄉村路線。)
The two universities exchange teaching materials and run a joint summer programme. (這兩所大學交流教材，並合辦暑期課程。)
The still lake reflects the snowy mountains so clearly that it looks like a giant mirror. (平靜的湖面清晰映出雪山，看起來就像一面巨大的鏡子。)
The strongest argument for change is simply cost, since the old system wastes both money and staff time. (支持改變最有力的理由就是成本，因為舊制度既浪費金錢也浪費員工時間。)

meaning: n. 資源；可運用的條件
example: Time is a limited resource in every classroom, so teachers must decide which activities deserve the most attention. (時間是每個教室裡有限的資源，因此教師必須決定哪些活動最值得投入。)
The new sports facility is open to all local residents at weekends. (新的運動設施週末開放給所有本地居民使用。)
Each candidate was asked to explain clearly how their previous experience would help them handle the demanding role. (每位求職者都被要求清楚說明，他們先前的經驗會如何幫助他們勝任這份要求很高的工作。)
Her calm manner is a great asset when customers start to complain. (客人開始抱怨時，她沉穩的態度是一大優勢。)
The orchestra will perform in the park on Sunday, provided the weather remains dry and the wind stays calm. (只要天氣保持乾燥、風勢平穩，樂團星期天將在公園演出。)
Keeping a strict balance between full-time study and part-time work proved much harder than she had originally expected. (在全職學業與打工之間維持嚴格的平衡，比她原先預期的還要難得多。)
Engineers estimate the final renovation will cost far more than the council originally promised voters. (工程師估計最後的整修費用將遠高於地方議會原先向選民承諾的金額。)
The remark sounded rude, but in context it was clearly meant as a joke. (那句話聽起來很無禮，但從上下文來看，顯然只是玩笑。)
Much of the credit for the discovery belongs to a young researcher who noticed a faint pattern in the data. (這項發現的大部分功勞歸於一位年輕研究員，他注意到數據中一個微弱的規律。)
The latest version of the software fixes several bugs but also removes a popular feature. (最新版軟體修正了幾個錯誤，但也移除了一項受歡迎的功能。)
The festival offers a variety of performances, from street acrobatics to quiet readings in the small local library. (這個節慶提供各式各樣的表演，從街頭特技到當地小圖書館裡的靜態朗讀都有。)
She applied to extend her student visa, but the office officially warned that processing could take several weeks. (她申請延長學生簽證，但辦事處正式警告處理可能需要好幾週。)
The proposal for a new car park was rejected at the public meeting. (新停車場的提案在公開會議上被否決了。)
They hired a professional photographer for the wedding, although a talented friend offered to do it all for free. (他們請了專業攝影師拍婚禮，儘管一位有才華的朋友主動表示願意免費包辦。)
The nurses' request for extra night staff was finally approved, though the change will only start next month. (護理師要求增加夜班人力的申請終於獲准，不過這項改變下個月才開始。)
The original plan was much simpler, but several unnecessary late changes made the whole project far more expensive. (最初的計畫簡單得多，但幾項不必要的後期變更讓整個專案貴了許多。)
Scientists observe the birds from a hidden hut to avoid affecting their behaviour. (科學家從隱蔽的小屋觀察鳥類，以免影響牠們的行為。)
The school informed all parents about the sudden closure, sending messages quickly enough for them to arrange childcare. (學校通知所有家長停課消息，訊息送得夠快，讓他們能安排托育。)
Clear communication between the sales office and the warehouse prevents shipping errors. (業務辦公室與倉庫之間清楚的溝通能避免出貨錯誤。)
The travel agency arranged everything, from flights to insurance, yet it actually forgot to confirm the hotel booking. (旅行社安排好一切，從機票到保險，卻竟然忘了確認飯店訂房。)
I recommend the small bakery near the bridge for its warm rye bread. (我推薦橋邊那家小麵包店，它的黑麥麵包是溫熱的。)
Caring for the river is a shared responsibility, so farmers and factories must both reduce their polluting waste. (照顧這條河是共同責任，因此農民和工廠都必須減少污染性廢棄物。)
The school needs additional funding for new books, yet the council has frozen its budget for three years. (學校需要額外經費買新書，但市議會已凍結預算三年。)
The machine looks complex, yet most faults can be fixed with a simple screwdriver and a little patience. (這台機器看起來很複雜，但多數故障用一把簡單螺絲起子和一點耐心就能修好。)
It is not appropriate to prescribe antibiotics for every cough, since most infections simply clear up without them. (每個咳嗽都開抗生素並不適當，因為大多數感染不用藥就會自行痊癒。)
The new software automatically checks long documents for spelling and grammar errors. (新軟體會自動檢查文件中的拼字和文法錯誤。)

meaning: n. 行政單位；管理部門
example: The university administration promised to answer every application within ten days, but many students still waited much longer. (大學行政單位承諾十天內回覆每份申請，但許多學生仍等了更久。)
A new medical certificate is now a requirement for every single applicant, which has slowed the process considerably. (新的醫療證明現在是每位申請人的必要條件，這讓流程慢了不少。)
The staff survey clearly revealed low morale, so managers promised to review workloads before the end of term. (員工調查清楚顯示士氣低落，因此主管承諾在學期結束前檢討工作量。)
Governments that invest in public early education often save considerable money later on healthcare and crime, according to economists. (經濟學家指出，投資公共幼兒教育的政府，日後往往能在醫療和犯罪防治上省下可觀經費。)
The majority of members supported the plan, yet the chair insisted on holding another formal vote next month. (多數成員支持這項計畫，但主席堅持下個月再舉行一次正式表決。)

meaning: adj. 聯邦的；聯邦政府的
example: Federal funding paid for the new road, but the town maintains it. (新路是用聯邦經費蓋的，但由鎮公所維護。)
Robots may replace routine factory jobs, but they also create new roles that increasingly demand different technical skills. (機器人可能取代例行的工廠工作，但也創造出越來越需要不同技術能力的新職務。)
The club committee voted to rebuild the old changing rooms, but postponed a decision on raising membership fees. (俱樂部委員會表決重建老舊更衣室，但延後決定是否調漲會員費。)
The website content was outdated, so the team rewrote every page before the launch. (網站內容已過時，因此團隊在上線前重寫了每一頁。)
A growing percentage of graduates now work in jobs unrelated to their degree, according to a recent national survey. (根據最近一項全國調查，現在有越來越高比例的畢業生從事與所學無關的工作。)
